os_processes.scope: Canonical-project script paths, executable identity, PID, parent PID and creation UTC only. Raw command lines, account identifiers and credential arguments are not retained.

privacy: No account identifiers, secrets, raw account snapshots or complete HTTP payload are retained. The full-API SHA is ingestion provenance only and cannot be replayed from this compact record.
